entities.name: Query GlmU
observations: 452 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular mass 48.06 kDa and theoretical pI 5.27.
Strong full-length homology to reviewed GlmU proteins, including 78.0% identity over 100% query coverage to Colwellia psychrerythraea Q47UE0.
N-terminal region is a pyrophosphorylase domain; central linker; C-terminal region is an N-acetyltransferase domain.
Predicted Pfam domains include NTP_transferase/NTP_transf_3 at residues 5-208 and C-terminal GMPPB_C plus Hexapep motifs.
Likely cytosolic homotrimer based on reviewed homolog annotations; localization and oligomerization are homology-supported, not directly measured for this sequence.

entities.name: GlmU
observations: Bifunctional enzyme catalyzing the final two reactions of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis.
N-terminal pyrophosphorylase activity converts GlcNAc-1-P plus UTP to UDP-GlcNAc plus diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.23.
C-terminal glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity converts GlcN-1-P plus acetyl-CoA to GlcNAc-1-P plus CoA; EC 2.3.1.157.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit and form homotrimers.
Associated biological processes include UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis, peptidoglycan biosynthesis, lipid A biosynthesis, and cell morphogenesis.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis
observations: GlmU catalyzes the terminal acetylation and uridyltransferase steps in the bacterial de novo UDP-N-acetylglucosamine pathway.
